new_zh_CN: 旅人，你已经无处可逃了。

original_text: 居然这里也有他们的爪牙！
new_en_US: Then it's a good thing I came to stop you.
new_zh_CN: 幸好我是来拦住你的，不是来逃命的。

original_text: 总算都杀退了，现在该怎么办？
new_en_US: That's the last of them here. Please tell me the next stop has chairs.
new_zh_CN: 这里的敌人总算退了。下一站总该有把椅子吧？

original_text: 探子回报，襄阳城又陷入了苦战！
new_en_US: A scout just brought word: Highbridge is under attack again.
new_zh_CN: 探子刚送来消息：高桥城又遭到进攻了。

new_en_US: Then we need to get back there.

original_text: 先别慌，过去一定是一场恶战。把武功练好，装备补齐，再准备上阵杀敌吧！
new_en_US: We do, but go prepared. Train your companions and check their gear before returning. This will be a hard fight.
new_zh_CN: 要回去，但得准备好。先培养伙伴、检查装备，再出发。这一战不会轻松。

new_en_US: Right. Everyone ready before we set out.
new_zh_CN: 明白。大家准备好了再走。
